name: loglead-mcp
description: Conversational log analysis: compare log folders/files for anomalies, distance, and structure using LogLead.
long_description:
Wraps LogLead's log-folder comparison analyses (LogDelta-style distance, anomaly, and visualization checks) as MCP tools. A log root is loaded, masked, and parsed once per session, and every later question reuses that parsed state across four levels: folder/file names, folder content, file content, and line content.

This bundle installs LogLead directly from the `main` branch of its GitHub repository at launch. Third-party dependencies (polars, scikit-learn, xgboost, shap, umap-learn, and others) are resolved as normal platform wheels via uv alongside it.

cache_dir.title: Cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where LogLead caches parsed/masked log data (parquet) between questions. Defaults to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/loglead-mcp if left blank.
